result.question: Why did Uzziah build watch towers?

readings.answer: Because he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain.
readings.support: Since he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain, he built towers in the desert

assessments.reason: The passage states, "Since he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain, he built towers in the desert," tying the towers to livestock, while "since he was a lover of the soil" is linked to having farmers and vinedressers, not to building towers.

result.reason: The text gives livestock as the reason for building towers, not Uzziah’s love of farming.
